_note: Authored tunable overrides. Only keys that deliberately differ from the schema defaults in js/tunables.js belong here — the schema stays the source of truth for what exists, its type, range and doc. Written by the M5 dashboard's Export button; hand-editable. Unknown keys are ignored with a console warning.
_tuned: M5.3, against the 50/80-turn simulator across seeds 20260829, 1, 777 and 4242.

_why.sent.maxRise: 0.035 -> 0.014. The schema default is the rate at which sentiment was FIRST observed to work; it is not a paced one. Measured over 80 turns at the default, the three deterministic western movements all declared by turn 10 — Alaska t8, Greater Idaho t9, Deseret t10 — so the West fell apart before a player had learned the board, and three separate crises arrived as one. The dial is clean and almost orthogonal: 0.035 -> first secession t9, 0.024 -> t13, 0.018 -> t17, 0.014 -> t22-t29 across four seeds, with the organised share, the movement reach span and the within-nation political spread all essentially unchanged. At 0.010 the pacing is better still but movements start failing to arrive at all — Greater Idaho never declares — so 0.014 is the last value before the game loses content. Across seeds it gives 2-5 secessions spread over turns 24-32 of 80, each far enough from the next to read as its own event.
